sentences.text: Mioglareola is an extinct genus of shorebirds belonging to the family Glareolidae.
The genus Mioglareola was described by Mayr and Smith in 2001.
The type species of the genus is Mioglareola gregaria.
The type species Mioglareola gregaria was originally described by Ballmann in 1979.
A second species, Mioglareola dolnicensis, was described by Švec in 1980.
The species Mioglareola gregaria has been found in the Czech Republic and Germany.
The species Mioglareola dolnicensis was previously classified in the genus Larus and is known from the Czech Republic.
This genus lived in Europe during the Early and Middle Miocene.
